name: EY-Parthenon
one_liner: EY's strategy and transactions brand, known for education and private equity strategy roots and for linking strategy with deals and corporate finance.
at_a_glance: Built on Parthenon Group, acquired by EY in 2014.
Since 2025 covers all of EY Strategy and Transactions: ~25,000 professionals in ~150 countries.
Three main areas: Strategy & Execution, Deals, and Corporate Finance.
Draws on the wider EY network of roughly 400,000 people.

rounds: First round: ~2 interviews mixing behavioral and case.
Final round: ~2-3 interviews, which may include a case with a data pack and sometimes a group case.
interview_process.case_style: Largely candidate-led; some cases give an information pack to digest before analysis. Commercial due diligence and market-sizing themes are common.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions on teamwork, accountability, and adaptability, plus motivation for strategy and transactions work.
interview_process.assessments: None standard for MBA consultant roles as far as public sources show.

what_they_look_for: Curious leaders who dig deeply into client businesses
Comfort with CEO- and board-level questions
culture: Strategy work closely tied to transactions, so pace can feel deal-driven.
Entrepreneurial feel inherited from Parthenon, within a large Big 4 platform.
why_us_angles: Does the strategy-plus-deals combination fit your finance background?
Which sectors (e.g., consumer, tech, PE) would you want to pursue at EY-Parthenon?
How does access to EY's tax, tech, and transaction specialists matter for the problems you want to solve?
prep_tips: Practice commercial due diligence cases: market size, growth drivers, competition, and a buy/no-buy call.
Practice skimming a dense data pack quickly and pulling out the few key facts.
Show how your finance fluency (e.g., reading financial statements) helps on deal-driven work.
Prepare to discuss why EY-Parthenon rather than MBB.
